name: Scatter quadrant
oneLiner: a glass plot stands up off a lit floor with two axes and a dashed cross; a field of glass beads drops in out of the camera one by one, then the brand drops last as a lit disc into the top right quadrant, which floods with the accent while the field falls back and the camera pushes in
say: when the speaker says everyone else trades one thing for another and the brand gets both ('they are fast or good, we are both'): cut in on the market, the brand dot lands on the word that claims the spot
